mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, password, phone, nickname, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{nickname}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, phone, nickname, avatar, receiver_name, shipping_phone, shipping_address, shipping_lat, shipping_lng, status, create_time, update_time FROM `user` WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, password, phone, nickname, avatar, receiver_name, shipping_phone, shipping_address, shipping_lat, shipping_lng, status, create_time, update_time FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET nickname = #{nickname}, avatar = #{avatar}, receiver_name = #{receiverName}, shipping_phone = #{shippingPhone}, shipping_address = #{shippingAddress}, shipping_lat = #{shippingLat}, shipping_lng = #{shippingLng} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.username, e.password, e.real_name, e.phone, e.shop_id, e.role_id, e.enabled, e.create_time, e.update_time, r.role_code AS role_code FROM employee e INNER JOIN role r ON e.role_id = r.id WHERE e.username = #{username}

SELECT e.id, e.username, e.password, e.real_name, e.phone, e.shop_id, e.role_id, e.enabled, e.create_time, e.update_time, r.role_code AS role_code FROM employee e INNER JOIN role r ON e.role_id = r.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rider (username, password, real_name, phone, enabled, work_status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{enabled}, #{workStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rider WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rider WHERE phone = #{phone}
